The established-full-rank caller sends all fatal/inconsistent statuses to non-retryable phase 44, while status 0 retains phase 43. Focused tests and existing regulator/cursor guards pass, as do strict checks on 247 modules. Current-source lowering confirms 86 fmpz functions and one arena. Actual alpha^3-alpha-1 arithmetic agrees under dynamic/GMP/fmpz across exact and poisoned oversized owners at counts 2, 4, 2, 4; direct sanitized cores use fixed 3 MiB checkpoints without retries/upstream allocation. High-water is 206448 bytes fmpz and 1995008 bytes GMP. No class-group timing claim or opt use.
